Pick a name for RecruitPro

Three names, each shown on the real redesigned HR portal (branch redesign, rendered headless with mock data). The whole identity swaps with one line. My pick is Plumbline: its metaphor carries the fairness story, and it had the cleanest quick conflict check.

Plumbline Recommended

PLUM-line (silent b)

“Every claim, measured true.”

Story
A plumb line is a weight on a string that shows true vertical: a standard that doesn't depend on anyone's opinion. Every candidate is held against the same line of cited evidence.
Look
Cobalt blue and cool slate, brass detail
Quick check
No conflict found in HR, identity-check or developer-tool products in a quick search; the only software-class registration found is cancelled.
Biggest risk
Search results are full of plumbing companies; the .com is probably taken.
Switch to it
export { default } from './presets/plumbline' in src/design/brand/active.ts (both portals)

Assay

uh-SAY

“Test every claim. Cite every source.”

Story
To assay gold is to test what it is really made of. Assay tests what each claim is made of, cites the result, and a person signs it off.
Look
Graphite and warm stone, one gold streak
Quick check
No conflict found in HR; many lab-software products use the word.
Biggest risk
Can be said “ASS-ay”; the name is common in lab software.
Switch to it
export { default } from './presets/assay' in src/design/brand/active.ts (both portals)

Gradus

GRAH-dus

“Evidence, one rung at a time.”

Story
Latin for “a step”, the rung of a ladder. It is the Evidence Ladder itself: every claim climbs one cited step at a time.
Look
Petrol blue-green and grey-green, serif wordmark
Quick check
No software or HR conflict found; unrelated marks in other classes.
Biggest risk
Can be read as “grade us”; two ways to say it.
Switch to it
export { default } from './presets/gradus' in src/design/brand/active.ts (both portals)

“No conflict found” means a quick web search found none. It is not a clearance. Before adopting any name, run a formal trademark search (USPTO, EUIPO, UKIPO, India; classes 9, 35, 42) and check domains and social handles. Full details: docs/design/NAMING.md.
